Durable exact non-initial Configuration approval is implemented under the current ACTIVE Merchant Controller with trusted authenticated principal, exact validation/impact-review/package evidence and current Controller Relationship affinity. Historical approval remains append-only but is applicable only while its exact Controller Relationship remains current.
R3A real replacement activation and R3B fresh basis-affined reinstatement composition are conforming complete; historical approval or activation replay cannot create a new decision.

Real replacement activation binds trusted execution context, OPEN unsuspended Merchant Account, current ACTIVE Controller authority, exact current approval/evidence, concurrency/compatibility/serving admission and atomic activation. Committed activation replay remains historical replay rather than a new mutation.

A superseded immutable Configuration Revision requires fresh exact basis-affined validation/package evidence, impact review and current Controller approval before trusted activation creates a new immutable activation fact; historical approval and historical activation replay remain insufficient.
Exact validated candidate/base/package orchestration and mandatory complete assessment aggregation; fixture assessments do not certify business coverage.

Later IMP-11/12/13 semantic portfolios are not claimed.
Concrete application composition produces and durably binds the exact Configuration impact review; callers cannot satisfy R4C with an arbitrary fabricated assessment list.
Production exact-result impact orchestration, executable IMP-05 owner portfolio and concrete durable application composition are conforming complete within the accepted IMP-05 Configuration scope.

Publication evidence, consumer acknowledgement and downstream business effects remain distinct.

Registered Standing Free reconciliation invokes its real Commercial owner operation only after historical contract resolution, current registration, authoritative source and Merchant Scope reconstruction, and bounded current scheduled-principal revalidation.

Recovery/attempt evidence, immutable catalogue history, durable publication persistence, exact v1.10 manifest representation, conditional supporting-commercial evidence, trusted publication admission and production rollout ordering are conforming complete. The 19 September C3 closure evidence records tests-first RED, exact production composition and final full Maven/PostgreSQL verification at 1,271 unit/governance + 446 integration tests. Merchant Account semantics/transaction remain commercially independent. C3 is complete; IMP-08C remains open on C4B2, C4E, C5A and C5.

MerchantAccountEstablished source/discovery/publication integration is conforming complete: exact historical owner occurrence -> exact current Standing Free reaction discovery -> durable C4D1 receipt -> technical published_at. Unknown historical affinity remains unresolved, publication remains distinct from consumer acknowledgement, and the exact current code/test blobs passed Maven Tests #916 (1,271 unit/governance + 446 PostgreSQL integration tests).

Exact production/migration/test state passed Maven Tests #919.
